<function name="AddHue" parent="Color" type="classfunc">
	<description>Converts a <page>Color</page> into [HSV color space](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV), adds given value to the [hue](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hue) and converts it back into an RGB color.

A slightly more efficient combination of <page>COLOR:GetHue</page> & <page>COLOR:SetHue</page>

This is useful to quickly change the hue of the color without changing saturation or luminance, allowing for things like easy theming.
</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<added>2025.01.23</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="hue" type="number">The hue value to add in degrees [0, 360).</arg>
	</args>
</function>
